_note: What you see: The General tab of the administration: restart setup, default permissions, personal dashboards on or off, limits per person and per dashboard, Launchpad as default app, allowed websites and custom CSS.

Opslag, groepen, voorbeelddashboards en: Storage, groups, sample dashboards and roles in five steps. Your current dashboards stay.
